minorIssues.description: StreamingMultipartPart.rawHeaders is set to `Buffer.alloc(0)` — the rawHeaders field is a Sprint 1 carry-over in the public type but is not yet populated with actual raw header bytes. Not flagged as `as any` or `as never`, but `as unknown as` is a code-smell pattern; widening the shim's DicerPartStream.on overloads would remove the need. Tracked as a known design tradeoff per the assumption.

The finally block is intentionally empty (only a TODO comment for Sprint 3).
